summary: Trivest’s first-property plan centers on three confirmed or strongly supported workstreams: launch Homebody with a staged resident transition, repair marketing attribution through cleaner lead sources and tracking numbers, and establish recurring preventive-maintenance inspections. Later calls confirmed the decision to proceed with Homebody and finalized portfolio-wide RV Index 2.0 screening conditions. AI call routing, tour scheduling, the TAA application, electronic-notice consent, payment restrictions, insurance changes, Cobu scope, and exact Homebody cutover dates remain open.
